at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary amounts with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0002.content: Signal domain failures by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using codes like "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity", "negative_amount" and "invalid_amount"; never raise bare ValueError in ledgerly modules.

at-0003.title: Normalize amounts with to_money and ZERO
at-0003.content: Convert any incoming amount through ledgerly.money.to_money before comparing or storing it, and compare against ZERO rather than a literal Decimal; store the normalized Decimal on the model.

at-0007.title: Money operations take keyword-only idempotency_key
at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation, by scanning `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and returning the original result; include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry written via `audit.record`.

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

[team convention] Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 need a second approver (finance policy FIN-2026-03): accept an optional keyword-only `approved_by=None` (callers that do not need approval keep working). Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval; above it, raise BillingError("approval_required") when `approved_by` is missing.
